item.description:
AgentDock 1.5.4: questions with previews.

  • Claude's questions with a preview: when Claude Code asks a question and shows a preview beside the options, the Inbox and the question pop-up now show the question and its options, and picking one answers it. Before, the card said "Waiting for you in a form AgentDock can't read yet". The preview itself stays in the terminal.

AgentDock 1.5.3: one fix.

  • Claude Code agent teams in cmux: a team lead no longer flashes "needs you" each time it ends a turn while its teammates are still working. cmux reports such a lead as "Waiting" (on its background work), which AgentDock read as waiting on you, so a card and the question pop-up appeared for a few seconds and went again.

AgentDock 1.5.2: two fixes.

  • Claude Code agent teams: a team lead waiting at an empty prompt no longer shows "Waiting for you in a form AgentDock can't read yet", and ⌥⌥ messages and Inbox replies to it are no longer refused as unsent text. The list of teammates under Claude's status line hid its empty prompt from AgentDock.
  • Menu bar menu: an agent with a very long title no longer stretches the menu across the screen. Titles are cut at a word, in the Dock menu too.

AgentDock 1.0.1: fixes from testing every terminal with real agents.

  • iTerm: ⌥⌥ messages and Inbox replies are sent again. They were typed into the agent's input but never submitted.
  • kitty: clicking an agent brings its own window forward, not just kitty. Messages with backslashes (a path like C:\temp) arrive exactly as typed.
  • herdr: questions from agents in herdr can be answered from the Inbox again; newer herdr versions wouldn't show a waiting agent's screen. An agent that appeared before herdr recognised it no longer stays without its name and logo.
  • Claude Code in a terminal opened from the Claude app now shows as that terminal instead of "Claude app", so ⌥⌥ can type to it and clicking finds its tab.
  • When an agent has unsent text in its prompt, AgentDock now says to clear it there, instead of always saying "in cmux".

Tested end to end with Claude Code in cmux, tmux, herdr, iTerm, WezTerm, kitty, Terminal and Ghostty.

AgentDock 1.0: now $19, after a 7-day free trial.

  • Try everything for 7 days. After the trial, the status dots and the hover card keep working for free. Answering from the Inbox, ⌥⌥ messages and answering from your iPhone need a license.
  • $19 once (plus tax where it applies), for up to 3 Macs. Buy it from the menu or Settings › License. After paying, your browser brings you straight back to AgentDock with the key filled in.
  • Lost your key? agentdockapp.com/activate finds it again from your email and the card you paid with.
  • Settings › License shows your trial, your license, and frees a Mac when you move to a new one.
  • The iPhone page says when answering is locked, instead of quietly doing nothing.
  • Fixed: two copies of AgentDock running at once (say, a test build) could cut each other off from Claude Code's hook.

Thank you for trying AgentDock early.
